trigger: They are demanding my phone password
description: What to do if an officer insists you unlock your phone or reveal your password.

steps.text: Stay calm. Your phone and communications are private (s.37).
Ask on what legal authority you are being asked to unlock your phone.
You may remain silent and decline until you speak to a lawyer (s.35(2)).
Do not delete anything; that can look like obstruction. Simply ask questions.
If they take the phone, ask for a written record of what was taken.
Note the officer's name, number, and the time.
Call your lawyer before giving any password.
